author: GamingBolt
description:
Even in a bumper year like 2026, which feels like it's only just getting started with the big releases, there are more than a few stinkers. Among those are titles that couldn't measure up to expectations, regardless how little they were hyped. 

And yet, even with the faintest of hope for something fun, one's disappointment is immeasurable and their days ruined. Let's count down the ten most disappointing games of the year thus far, starting with.
title: Top 10 Most DISAPPOINTING Games of 2026 So Far

author: GamingBolt
description:
Another Crimson Desert patch has officially gone live, and make no mistake – it's a big one. Okay, maybe “fairly sizable” is a more accurate assessment, but consider for a moment that we're currently in the fourth month of post-launch support. 

Between boss rematches, difficulty settings, new skills, balance changes, tons of new mounts and pets, re-blockading, and whatnot, how much more could the developer possibly add?

Thumbnail credit: Nexusmod user: K0DY4K
title: Crimson Desert Latest Patch - 10 Exciting Gameplay Additions You Need to Know
